protocol_revision_reason: Clarify pre-trigger bin endpoints before any response-feature values are extracted; the feasibility gate and scientific question are unchanged.
purpose: Test whether observable pre-shock market response behavior adds predictive information beyond ordinary price, flow, volatility and liquidity summaries without claiming recovery of the latent MFSM state.
scientific_question: After the existing independent BTC spot decline crosses -1% over exactly five minutes, do pre-trigger measurements of realized sell-pressure impact and bid replenishment improve the 30-minute downside-before-recovery forecast beyond matched comparators using the same observable history?

allowed: observational predictive value of prespecified public response-law summaries
development feasibility of computing those summaries from causal receipt-time market data
partial-identification language when multiple latent states remain observationally compatible
not_allowed: identification of hidden debt, leverage, margin headroom or liquidation-distance mass
causal effect of aggressive selling without an independent identification design

event_contract.crossing_rule: first second moving from return > -0.01 to return <= -0.01

label_contract.primary_target: downside barrier hit before recovery barrier within 30 minutes

inheritance.rule: The inherited event and label definitions are copied for this new experiment and are not modifications to E001-LIQ-OBS-1.

response_history.bin_anchor: For integer k >= 0, pressure-bin start = trigger - 1800 seconds + 5k seconds and end = start + 5 seconds.
response_history.pressure_trade_interval: (start, end] by local receipt time; a trade exactly at end belongs to this bin, not the next bin.
response_history.book_state_endpoint_rule: For start and end midpoints/depth, use only reconstructed book state available at or before that endpoint by local receipt time.
response_history.replenishment_interval: (pressure_bin_end, pressure_bin_end + 5 seconds] by local receipt time; the existing persistent-addition helper may include observations at its endpoint.
response_history.window_end_meaning: The last pressure-bin end considered is trigger - 5 seconds; consideration alone does not make a bin eligible.
response_history.shared_bin_eligibility: A bin is eligible for either response summary only if its pressure end <= trigger - 5 seconds and its replenishment end = pressure end + 5 seconds is strictly earlier than trigger. On this five-second grid, exclude the final considered pressure bin ending at trigger - 5 seconds; the last eligible pressure bin ends at trigger - 10 seconds and its replenishment ends at trigger - 5 seconds.
response_history.reason_for_end_cutoff: Every eligible pressure bin and its five-second replenishment interval end strictly before the trigger, including updates exactly at the replenishment endpoint.
response_history.required_book: Bybit linear BTCUSDT top 50 levels reconstructed causally from incremental L2
response_history.required_trades: Bybit linear BTCUSDT aggressor trades available by local receipt timestamp
response_history.missing_policy: Any bin with missing or stale required book state, an epoch/reset boundary, or missing trade continuity is unavailable; never impute zero.

pretrigger_sell_impact_beta_5s.interpretation: observed local price response to normalized net aggressive sell pressure; descriptive, not causal
pretrigger_sell_impact_beta_5s.eligible_bins: q_k > 0 with valid positive top-50 depth and valid midpoint at bin start and end, subject to response_history.shared_bin_eligibility

pretrigger_bid_replenishment_beta_5s.interpretation: observed bid-replenishment response following normalized net aggressive sell pressure; descriptive, not causal
pretrigger_bid_replenishment_beta_5s.eligible_bins: same shared pressure-bin eligibility as pretrigger_sell_impact_beta_5s, with valid causal book continuity throughout the following five-second replenishment interval
pretrigger_bid_replenishment_beta_5s.persistence_rule: an added bid quantity must remain present for at least one second; use the existing causal persistent-addition semantics

matched_comparison_draft.fairness_rule: The response model may add only the two declared response coefficients. A same-information comparator must receive the same current-state features and neutral summaries derived from the same pre-trigger history.

development_data_policy.local_tardis_first_of_month_days: development_and_software_feasibility_only; prior experiments have already inspected some events and outcomes
development_data_policy.existing_spot_event_discovery: may be reused only to count price-defined candidate events and calendar blocks; do not read labels or L2 outcomes for this feasibility milestone
development_data_policy.fresh_confirmation_requirement: a new continuous prospective period or another untouched predeclared archive is required before a confirmation claim

feasibility.pass_condition: At least one development date has all four required files with valid headers and at least one price-defined accepted BTC candidate event falls on a complete-input date.

binance_historical_futures_l2.known_contract: Historical Futures L2 offers T_DEPTH and BTCUSDT S_DEPTH; access documentation requires a Futures account and a whitelisted API key. Cost/eligibility is not assumed.
binance_historical_futures_l2.use_rule: Do not request credentials or download data until the owner explicitly chooses this route.

prospective_public_collector.rule: A new continuous period must be fixed before launch; do not silently extend the expired 2026-09-25 window.

next_gate: Run the read-only field/calendar feasibility audit. If it passes, implement outcome-blind response-feature extraction on development-only dates and freeze neutral comparator summaries plus a fresh evaluation calendar before any scoring.
